text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time after the Arima Kinen had ended, 
I stopped by a fast-food restaurant—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, me, me, me! I wanna eat melon! The 
orange kind!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love to have some seafood. The 
sightseeing boat sounds intriguing as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How about Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I want to see drift ice. Like this.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Wowww! A place like this really 
exists!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ran into Winning Ticket and the others 
cheerfully chatting around a travel 
brochure.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer! Yoo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see, Hokkaido! Once everyone's races 
settle down a bit, then!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm seriously so excited! A trip 
with the three of us♪ A trip~♪ A 
triiiip~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
How long are you going to stay on cloud 
nine?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on~! We haven't really done 
stuff like this as a trio very often!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've got sooooo many memories of competing 
in races and stuff, though!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So you see, it makes me really happy that 
we can make so many fun memories together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, we've reached a good stopping 
point.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah, a temporary truce, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"—By the way, if we combine all the 
candidate spots everyone just mentioned, a 
two-day, one-night trip won't be nearly 
enough time."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Then we can just skip the drift ice.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no way! Let's go, we can make up for 
it with extra time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No, really, don't worry about it. It'll 
just add to our lodging expenses anyway."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I agree with Ticket. I want to take a 
trip that all three of us will enjoy."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Since we're already here, let's take our 
time looking around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ... ...Busybody.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's settled then.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yay! A road trip across Hokkaido! In that 
case, I wanna check out Hakodate 
Racecourse too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at the map before saying 
anything!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The lively voices of the three of them did 
not cease for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fan
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me! Are you... Winning Ticket?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Yes! That's right!

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Wow, it's really you! I went to 
watch the Arima Kinen in person! During 
the Ticket-zo chants, I was just bawling 
my eyes out...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really?! I'm so happy, thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...! If it's okay with you, would 
you... take a picture with me?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Of course! Let's take tons of photos!

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fan
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Haven't people been talking to you 
every single day lately?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you've really become quite the 
popular one.

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait!? BNW!? I'm sorry, I was just so 
surprised by Ticket-san...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, let's take a photo with all 
four of us! Come on, you two, over here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we took some photos with 
wonderful expressions, and before I knew 
it, one of them was framed in the 
Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of them excitedly 
planned out the trip itinerary. And then—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright, destination decided. Lodging is 
booked, travel route confirmed. All that's 
left is...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Now for the food, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in search of even more delicious 
food, we headed to the bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Arrived at the bookstore~! Where is it, 
that Hokkaido gourmet guidebook!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, more importantly, what's that 
stuff piled up over there...?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Winning Ticket: Footsteps Across the 
Twinkle Series"? Ticket, you published a 
book?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're already on sale! Actually, you 
see—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I was barely involved! I just got 
a few photos taken, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's quite thick. '..The Nakayama 
Racecourse was burning hot at the end of 
the year. The Ticket-zo calls 
resonated...' Oh-ho."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, look at this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Favorite food: tasty food! Sports I'm 
good at: all of them!" Like, that doesn't 
even answer the question.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, th-that's... so embarrassing!! Don't 
say it out loud!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, forgive me. I was just so happy to 
see you in a book.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Hooh. 'A word to the two from BNW,' 
huh? Let's see..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After reading Winning Ticket's comment, 
the two of them... quietly closed the 
booklet.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
............ Don't write stuff like this 
in a book.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll buy it and take my time reading 
it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's the register... Are you 
buying it for me!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the page caught in a brief glance, 
passionate words dedicated to the two of 
them were written at great length.
